title: Shreveport: The Industrial Heart of Ternium in the United States
summary: From advanced manufacturing to skilled jobs, the Shreveport facility plays a key role in strengthening Ternium's industrial presence in the United States.
body_markdown:
Share


From advanced manufacturing to skilled jobs, the Shreveport facility plays a key role in strengthening Ternium's industrial presence in the United States.


In Shreveport, Louisiana, Ternium extends its U.S. footprint beyond commercial operations and into manufacturing. As part of its industrial network across the Americas, the facility transforms steel into[value-added products](https://us.ternium.com/en/products) while supporting investment, industrial development and skilled employment in the region.


The Shreveport facility plays both a local and strategic role. It manufactures steel products in the United States while connecting customers to the strength, scale and expertise of one of the leading steel companies in the region.


**Manufacturing in the U.S.**


At Shreveport, Ternium transforms flat steel into high-value coated products through galvanizing and painting processes designed for demanding applications.


The facility also serves as a gateway to a broader industrial network. Across the Americas, the company operates an integrated system of facilities serving industries such as construction, automotive, energy, manufacturing and home appliances. For customers in the United States, that means access to the advantages of a large-scale industrial network combined with the responsiveness and proximity of a local operation.


**Investing in Industrial Capabilities**


To remain competitive in a rapidly evolving manufacturing environment, Ternium continues investing in[technology, automation and operational improvements](https://us.ternium.com/en/innovation) at its Shreveport facility.


Recent modernization efforts include upgrades to the galvanizing line, incorporating new equipment and automation aimed at enhancing operational performance, increasing flexibility and strengthening safety conditions for employees.


Rather than remaining static, the facility continues to evolve alongside advances in manufacturing technology and the changing needs of the U.S. market.


**The People Behind the Operation**


Behind every coil processed and every order delivered is a team of specialists across production, maintenance, engineering, quality and logistics whose expertise helps keep the operation running efficiently and ensures products meet customer expectations.


For Ternium, strengthening industrial capabilities and investing in people go hand in hand. Through training and professional development[programs](https://us.ternium.com/en/careers#programs) , the company helps employees build the technical knowledge required by an increasingly advanced steel industry.


In Shreveport, that commitment translates into skilled manufacturing opportunities that contribute to the local economy while helping prepare the workforce for the future of industrial production.


**A Local Operation with Broader Reach**


The Shreveport site plays a unique role within Ternium's U.S. footprint. Together with commercial operations in Houston, it connects customers in the United States to a broader industrial network while supporting local manufacturing and steel processing capabilities.


Supported by a skilled workforce and ongoing modernization efforts, the facility contributes to industrial development and creates opportunities for the communities it serves.
